import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df1, df2):
    # Prepare feature matrix
    X = df1.copy()
    if isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame):
        numeric_X = X.select_dtypes(include="number")
        X = numeric_X if numeric_X.shape[1] > 0 else pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=False)
    else:
        X = pd.DataFrame(X)

    if X.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("No usable features available for selection.")

    # Prepare target vector
    if isinstance(df2, pd.DataFrame):
        y = df2.iloc[:, 0]
    elif isinstance(df2, pd.Series):
        y = df2
    else:
        y = pd.Series(df2)

    # Align and remove missing values
    data = X.join(y.rename("_target_"))
    data = data.dropna()
    X_clean = data.drop(columns="_target_")
    y_clean = data["_target_"]

    if X_clean.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("No usable features available after cleaning.")

    # Select K best features (k=2, or fewer if the dataset has fewer features)
    k = min(2, X_clean.shape[1])
    selector = SelectKBest(score_func=f_classif, k=k)
    selector.fit(X_clean, y_clean)

    mask = selector.get_support()
    selected_names = X_clean.columns[mask]
    selected_scores = selector.scores_[mask]

    # Order selected features by score descending
    order = selected_scores.argsort()[::-1]
    selected_features = selected_names[order].tolist()

    # Correlation heatmap for the selected features
    corr = X_clean[selected_features].corr()
    ax = sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, cmap="coolwarm", vmin=-1, vmax=1, square=True)
    ax.set_title("Correlation Heatmap of Selected Features")

    return selected_features, ax
